pathAssistantSteps.info:
Activated - contract is live.

  • Contract term is running
  • Schedule renewal review 90 days before end date
  • Any amendments require a Change Order Opportunity

Draft - contract being prepared.

  • Verify Account, start date, and contract term
  • Link to the winning Order via Order__c
  • Confirm billing currency matches BAN currency
  • Click Activate Contract when all details are confirmed
